function: DRL jointly selects semantic-codebook bits, IRS reflective coefficients and subchannel assignment to maximize secure semantic spectrum efficiency (p. 12, 17).
system: Tx with M=3 antennas, single-antenna users and eavesdropper, passive reflecting IRS with 64 elements, OFDMA with 3 subchannels of 90 kHz; carrier band not stated (p. 20-21).
method: Hybrid deep RL: NoisyNet dueling DQN (bits, subchannels) and NoisyNet SAC (IRS coefficients), CNN/MLP state fusion; VQ-VAE codec pre-trained, then fine-tuned (p. 13, 18).
data_channel: Simulated: Rician for Tx-IRS and IRS-user links, Rayleigh for Tx-user links, log-distance path loss; images from PASCAL VOC-2007 and ImageNet for the semantic codec (p. 21).
test_conditions: Codec trained at 10 dB SNR and validated over SNR; DRL evaluated while sweeping noise variance and IRS elements; no unseen scenario stated (p. 24, 26).
baselines: Non-learned: AO (40 iterations), no IRS, JPEG2000/BPG+Turbo; learned: HDRL [17], NdeHDRL-DT (TD3), CNN-AE codec; PL-SS [13], AL-SS [9]; ablations (p. 21-23).
metrics: S-SSE, semantic security (SSIM/LPIPS-based), reward, SSIM/LPIPS of reconstruction, CPU execution time (p. 10-12, 24-29).
complexity: Measured CPU time: NdeHDRL+SCA-SS 14.64 ms versus 512-1232 ms for the AO scheme at 20-60 iterations; no analytic order given (p. 28-29).
q1_support: p. 21: "follow Rician fading models"; custom Rician/Rayleigh simulator with its own path loss, no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 26: "semantic security performance versus different number of IRS"; only sweeps of IRS size and noise variance, no model trained in one scenario and tested in another, no adaptation to a new condition.
q3_support: p. 24: "obtains higher rewards than the HDRL scheme" (HDRL [17] is an earlier DRL scheme of the same authors, p. 21); p. 28: "can outperform the Traditional" Method scheme (AO algorithm, p. 23) in S-SSE.
q4_support: p. 29: "our proposed scheme is over 60 times more efficient in terms of execution"; Table IV gives measured CPU time, NdeHDRL + SCA-SS 14.64 ms against 512.34 to 1231.67 ms for the AO scheme.
q5_support: p. 21: "The Database is set as PASCAL VOC-2007"; public image datasets of the semantic task only, channels are simulated, and no code or data link is given.
notes: Included, area 3: the learned physical-layer action is the IRS amplitude/phase configuration (p. 17), chosen jointly with codebook bits and subchannels (above-physical decisions, so the joint rule of above_phy applies); the transmit beamformer is not learned. Objective is a secure semantic metric (S-SSE), so the reviewer may confirm that function. Default IRS size is 64 (p. 21) while Figs. 7-8 sweep 16 to 512 elements; the text does not say whether each size is retrained. HDRL-DS in Figs. 5, 7, 8 is taken as the conventional HDRL of [17] (p. 21); the NdeHDRL-DT (TD3), CSO-SS and fixed-layer schemes are variants and were not counted for q3. PDF is the arXiv version of the paper.
